key_figures.question: Q1
key_figures.figure: preprocessing panels / U-Net diagrams / segmentation examples / confusion matrix
key_figures.role: show image cleanup, architecture and qualitative segmentation; compare model metrics
key_figures.cannot_prove: generalization to unseen boreholes or thin cracks without grouped holdout and scale-ground-truth

key_figures.question: Q2
key_figures.role: make geometric pipeline inspectable and expose fit heterogeneity
key_figures.cannot_prove: DBSCAN/robust-fit correctness or plausibility; histograms hide extreme rows unless table/residuals are checked

key_figures.question: Q3
key_figures.figure: raw/smoothed contour + equal vs curvature sampling + JRC charts/table
key_figures.role: illustrate sampling sensitivity and local roughness
key_figures.cannot_prove: curvature sampling is more accurate without an external roughness ground truth; clipped JRC can create artificial agreement

key_figures.question: Q4
key_figures.figure: 3D borehole/fracture network + connectivity levels + uncertainty/recommendation bars
key_figures.role: communicate spatial structure and decision ranking
key_figures.cannot_prove: weighted connectivity is calibrated probability or recommended hole yields greater real information gain

recommended_figure_rules: always pair segmentation examples with per-group error metrics and holdout identity
for periodic fits show residuals/inliers and flag rejected/implausible fits, not only overlay
for JRC show raw Z2 and saturation counts alongside clipped JRC
for connectivity/recommendation add weight/scale sensitivity and expected-information-gain validation
